notes.title: A new gameplay for a better start ! Devlog #1
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 👋

First off, a huge thank you to everyone who played our first demo. We’ve been heads-down making major gameplay changes, and we’re excited to finally share a peek at what’s coming next!

[h2]🛠️ What’s Changing?[/h2]
We’ve shifted gears on the game design to focus on something more accessible and fun, and more aligned with our inspirations. Here’s what’s new in the upcoming demo:
[list]
[*] 🧩 One central grid — cleaner, tighter gameplay.
[*] 🧍‍♂️ Unique customers — each with special abilities that shake things up!
[*] 😻 Even cuter designs — because why not turn up the charm?
[/list]
These changes aim to create a smoother and more engaging experience that invites players to dive deeper into SushiCat world.
Some screenshots :
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45467352/f2905bcdd6bffef3b6fad777ed09a95bdff61fc4.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45467352/5e9d0fbb3a928e79b3ebbf7c3f48f55f9a7baf8f.png[/img]
[h2]🗓️ When Can You Play?[/h2]
We're aiming to drop the new demo during Steam Next Fest — so not long now! 🥳

Also, we're getting ready to launch a Discord server, where you'll be able to:
[list]
[*] Share your feedback
[*] Follow our dev progress
[*] Join a growing community of food-loving players
[/list]
We seriously can’t wait to show you more. Stay tuned, and thanks again for being part of this journey!

Flo et Ali — SushiCat Dev Team 🍣
